summary: Iteration 28: full backend + frontend verification of the new order-level profit & profit-analytics feature. Created /app/backend/tests/test_profit_iter28.py (46 tests) and test_profit_refund_iter28.py (2 tests): 47 passed, 1 skipped (no refunded orders in DB). Verified per-order profit math against raw order snapshots for all 8 delivered orders + a freshly created synthetic COD order, all 5 named periods + custom range (400 without dates, 400 on bad format, correct label/start/end), summary internal consistency (gross_profit = net_revenue - purchase_cost; net_profit = gross_profit + delivery_collected - delivery_cost - refunds; daily[] sums to realized totals and is date-sorted), cancelled/realized order counts cross-checked against /api/admin/orders, breakdown sorting + qty reconciliation vs realized non-cancelled order items, coupon aggregation reconciled 1:1 with order coupon codes (incl. visibility), inventory valuation totals/sorting + batch purchase_price precedence (10 units @7.5 raised value by exactly 75; delete restored it; older batch price never overwritten; batch without price = null). PUT /admin/orders/{id}/delivery-cost verified on a SYNTHETIC order: 30 reduced net profit by exactly 30, persisted, restored; delivery_charge +25 adjusted final_amount by +25 and was restored; negative cost/charge -> 400; unknown order -> 404. Security: anonymous and customer tokens get 401/403 on all 6 admin profit endpoints; GET /api/orders and /api/orders/{id} contain no delivery_cost / batch_allocations / item.cost_price while admin still sees them. Frontend: /admin/profit loads with all 11 KPI cards, both charts, all 6 period buttons and all 4 tabs (Overview/Products & Categories/Coupon Impact/Inventory Value) rendering data; AdminOrderDetail 'Profit (internal)' card renders full waterfall and the delivery-cost editor saved (1178.48 -> 1153.48 for 25, margin 28.98% -> 28.37%) and restored to 0/40 with toast. All modified real data restored (TEST-RET-ORDER-1: delivery_cost 0, delivery_charge 40, final_amount 4106); synthetic orders cancelled, test batches deleted.

minor.issue: totals.products counts product-PIN inventory rows, not distinct products (same product appears once per PIN, e.g. 'Almonds (Badam)' x3, 364 'products in stock' for ~a few dozen SKUs). Consider labelling it 'stock rows' or de-duplicating by product_id.

Mixed-cost fallback assumes priced batches are consumed first: remaining = available - priced_qty valued at product.cost_price. If batch quantities exceed available_quantity (reserved units), priced_val can exceed the true on-hand value. Not reproducible with current data but worth clamping.

Per-item revenue/profit uses unit_price (incl. embedded GST when gst.pricing=inclusive) and ignores coupon discounts, so by_product/by_category margins (flat 28%) are not consistent with order-level net margin (25.11%). Acceptable as an analysis view but should be documented in the UI note.
Editing delivery_charge mutates final_amount even for delivered/paid orders without writing an audit trail; payment_status/paid amount is not reconciled. Consider logging the adjustment.

Refund-reduction path could not be exercised: no order in the DB has payment_status=refunded / wallet refund ledger entries, so _refunds_by_order() aggregation remains untested end-to-end (test skipped, not failed).

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Custom' with empty dates short-circuits load() so the previously fetched period's KPIs stay on screen while the badge still shows the OLD period label - looks like real data for the custom range. Show an empty/prompt state instead.
load() uses `catch { /* noop */ }` and the inventory fetch uses .catch(() => {}) - API failures leave stale/blank cards with no error state or retry (violates loading/success/error requirement).

issues: Custom range uses native <input type="date"> (browser default picker) instead of the shadcn calendar/popover used elsewhere - inconsistent with the rest of the admin UI.
Inventory Value table repeats the same product for every PIN with identical numbers, making it hard to read; consider grouping by product with a PIN column expander.

critical_code_review_comments: compute_order_profit uses order.subtotal (post product/combo discount) as the revenue base and only reports gross_product_sales informationally - correct per spec, but gross_sales - product_discount - coupon_discount will not equal net_revenue when order.subtotal is not exactly mrp*qty - product_discount; a defensive assertion/log would catch data drift.
profit.py is dependency-light and clean (371 lines, no _id leakage, all async, Pydantic-validated input, env-based config) - no structural issues found.

PUT /admin/pincodes uses payload.model_dump() (full replace), so any client that omits delivery_cost silently nulls it; AdminPinCodes.js does send it, but the endpoint would be safer with exclude_unset.
